label: weak: late original-phase tokens (positions 7-8) of long sequences
explanation: Sparse (~1% of steps) and diffuse. The clearest tendency is in the original phase at positions 7-8 (rate 7.6x at orig_idx 7 and 22.9x at orig_idx 8, so mostly L=8-9 sequences), where it carries ~57% of activation mass. The largest activations (top quartile, 64% covered) are on the last original token just before <DEL>. Even there it fires on only ~13-23% of steps, and the input token modulates the rate: f, k, h, j, s are favored (3-4x) but are far from sufficient. The other ~38% of mass is in the copy phase, spread out with a mild peak at recall_idx 2-3 that no token condition captured. Never fires at t=0-1, almost never at <DEL>, and rarely in L<=5 sequences. No simple predicate gets past F1 ~0.26 (best dev F1 0.26, precision 0.27).

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token, by phase (input phase: f, s, w, t; copy phase: h, j, k, 1; delimiter step: ) and the input two steps back (most: s, t, f, <DEL>, r, w; least: 1, h, 2, -); timing cues that raise it most: L=9 & t=8, L=8 & t=7, t=8.
